title: 31 利息32 借贷33 死人
slug: 我有装备栏460上次那一位
content_zh:
;;
二十五颗精品气血丹凑齐了。
【你获得一颗精品气血丹的药效加持，气血+8%，肌肉+2%，壮骨+0.25%，抗毒+0.5%，需要持续装备6小时。】
“嗯，数据有变化。”
随着齐知玄持续变强，精品气血丹对他的滋补效果逐渐下降。
犹记得第一次装备精品气血丹，气血+50%，抗毒+16%。
不过这是正常现象。
毕竟现在的齐知玄，体内气血是那时数倍之多。
另外，长期服用同一种药物，身体也有可能产生一定的耐药性。
且不管这些，齐知玄一口气将二十五颗精品气血丹全部装备。
之后他开始勤学苦练，每天起早贪黑，坚持不辍。
而在已经完全领悟修炼之法的前提下，齐知玄比起其他人，先知先觉，不知少走了多少弯路。
以最强大的滋补，以最短的捷径，冲刺向第一道门槛。
五天一晃而过。
【画境入门，特效：粗细相宜】
一切水到渠成。
没有任何波折，没有一丝意外。
就像是做了一道数学题，所有步骤都在计算之内。
齐知玄波澜不惊取得突破，更上一层楼。
突破之后，他只感觉浑身一轻，整个人变得如同猴子一般灵敏，如同落叶一般轻盈。

静若处子，动若脱兔！
只需要动用很小量的气血，便能释放出很大的力量。
同样打出一拳，威力是过去的三倍不止。
“画境武者，已经可以算作是超人类了。”齐知玄轻声一叹。
转头看向鲍怜花，身为一个天骄，她也是进步斐然。
当然。
她再快也不可能快得过开挂的齐知玄。
不过没关系，齐知玄暗中引导、指点着她。
只是短短五天，鲍怜花已经能够在身上画出“小鸡吃米图”了。
另一边。
岳子勤和韩饷在狠狠打了一架后，二人似乎都受了刺激，竟然双双取得突破，迈入血流境大成。
白云霄没有立刻传授他俩第三层的口诀，让他们巩固沉淀一下，夯实根基。
同时，这也让大家明白了一件事。
虚假的对练，不如真实的战斗！
content_en:

Twenty-five fine Qi and Blood Pills were gathered together.
[You gain the medicinal effects of a high-quality Qi and Blood Pill, with Qi and Blood +8%, Muscles +2%, Bone Strengthening +0.25%, and Poison Resistance +0.5%. It needs to be equipped continuously for 6 hours. 】
"Well, the data has changed."
As Qi Zhixuan continued to grow stronger, the nourishing effect of the fine Qi and Blood Pills on him gradually declined.
I still remember the first time I equipped a high-quality Qi and Blood Pill, which gave me +50% Qi and +16% poison resistance.
But this is normal.
After all, the energy and blood in Qi Zhixuan's body now is several times that of that time.
In addition, if you take the same drug for a long time, your body may develop some resistance.
Regardless of this, Qi Zhixuan equipped all twenty-five fine Qi and Blood Pills in one go.
After that, he began to study hard and practice hard, getting up early and working late every day, and persevered.
On the premise that he had fully understood the method of cultivation, Qi Zhixuan was more foresighted than others and made many fewer detours.
Use the most powerful nourishment and the shortest shortcut to sprint towards the first threshold.
Five days flew by.
[Introduction to painting, special effects: appropriate thickness]
Everything falls into place.
No twists and turns, no surprises.
It's like doing a math problem, all steps are calculated.
Qi Zhixuan made a breakthrough calmly and reached a higher level.
After the breakthrough, he felt light all over his body. His whole body became as sensitive as a monkey and as light as a fallen leaf.
As quiet as a virgin, as active as a stripped rabbit!
Only a small amount of Qi and blood is needed to release a lot of power.
The same punch was more than three times as powerful as before.
"Painting realm warriors can already be regarded as superhuman beings." Qi Zhixuan sighed softly.
Turning to look at Bao Lianhua, as a talented person, she has also made great progress.
certainly.
No matter how fast she is, she can never be faster than the cheating Qi Zhixuan.
But it didn't matter, Qi Zhixuan secretly guided and pointed her out.
In just five days, Bao Lianhua was able to draw a "chicken eating rice" picture on her body.
other side.
After Yue Ziqin and Han Kai had a fierce fight, both of them seemed to be stimulated, and they both made a breakthrough and entered the blood flow realm.
Bai Yunxiao did not immediately teach them the third-level formula, letting them consolidate and consolidate their foundation.
At the same time, this also made everyone understand one thing.
Fake sparring is not as good as real fighting!
